redGreenRefactorEvidence.note: Added 7 new/updated pytest assertions against pr.yml text (skip_unchanged_head, wave_manifest.py wiring in policy-checks, artifact-gate rename, main_via_wave dedup, gitleaks always-on) before touching pr.yml. 6 of 9 workflow-scoped tests failed as expected (missing job/logic).

Edited .github/workflows/pr.yml: classify-tier now emits skip_unchanged_head and main_via_wave outputs; lint/typecheck/test/frontend/demo-frontend/policy-checks gated on skip_unchanged_head; lint/typecheck/frontend/demo-frontend main-tier condition excludes main_via_wave; removed validate-artifacts and generate-validation-artifact jobs; renamed ai-review to artifact-gate (tier=='main' only, calls wave_manifest.py --check-artifacts); policy-checks calls wave_manifest.py --issue for manifest membership; status-check updated needs/require lines accordingly; deployment-checks allows skipped for frontend/demo-frontend.

actionlint clean run against pr.yml; yaml.safe_load sanity parse; verified job dependency graph has no dangling 'needs' references after removing validate-artifacts/generate-validation-artifact/ai-review and adding artifact-gate.

implementationSummary: CI-WAVE-2: reworked .github/workflows/pr.yml per ADR-052. classify-tier gained skip_unchanged_head (skips issue-tier heavy jobs when a pull_request synchronize event leaves head SHA unchanged, base-only advance) and main_via_wave (true when main-tier is reached via a feature/*-wave head, i.e. wave->main) outputs. lint/typecheck/test/frontend/demo-frontend/policy-checks now gate on skip_unchanged_head. lint/typecheck/frontend/demo-frontend skip on main tier when main_via_wave is true, closing the CI double-run from the #658 audit addendum (status-check and deployment-checks now allow their 'skipped' result). validate-artifacts and generate-validation-artifact (heavy per-issue meta_prepare_executor/check_*.py re-run) were removed from issue tier entirely per ADR-052 point 6 (no full re-validation in CI at any tier). ai-review was renamed to artifact-gate, deferred to tier=='main' only, and calls agent-runtime/scripts/ci/wave_manifest.py --check-artifacts (the CI-WAVE-1 validator) against the wave manifest resolved from the wave branch name -- deterministic existence+status check, no LLM step. policy-checks now also calls wave_manifest.py --issue to enforce manifest membership for the target wave branch, in addition to the existing feature/*-issue-N branch-linkage check. gitleaks remains unconditional. Left artifact-gate's manifest resolution as a single, isolated step so #670 can later swap the read source to a compact status/issue-<N>.json record without touching the rest of the job.
assumptions: GitHub's pull_request webhook payload provides 'before'/'after' SHA fields on 'synchronize' actions (per GitHub API docs); this is the mechanism used to detect base-only PR updates with an unchanged head.

Direct-to-main/staging PRs not originating from a feature/*-wave head branch are treated as main_via_wave=false and still run lint/typecheck/frontend/demo-frontend at main tier (no issue-tier run preceded them, so no double-run to dedup).
risks: actionlint could not be executed against a live GitHub Actions run; only static lint + yaml parse + job-graph consistency were verified locally (no repo network to trigger an actual PR event).

docs/adr/052-wave-free-merge-deferred-artifact-gate.md, CONTEXT.md, and docs/handoffs/issue-658.md still reference the old 'ai-review' job name; these are outside the cleared file list for this issue and were left untouched -- flagged for a follow-up docs pass.

#670 (P1 Option A) will change what artifact-gate reads to a compact agent-runtime/artifacts/status/issue-<N>.json; only the manifest-resolution + wave_manifest.py call step was built here, intentionally minimal, per the issue's SEAM note.
